sentences.text: Benin -LRB- -LSB- bᵻˈniːn , _ - ˈnɪn -RSB- or - ; -LSB- bɛˈniːn -RSB- ; Bénin -LSB- benɛ̃ -RSB- -RRB- , officially the Republic of Benin -LRB- République du Bénin -RRB- and formerly Dahomey , is a country in West Africa .	Dahomey	Republic of Dahomey	West Africa	West Africa
It is bordered by Togo to the west , Nigeria to the east , and Burkina Faso and Niger to the north .	Togo	Togo	Nigeria	Nigeria	Burkina Faso	Burkina Faso	Niger	Niger

The majority of its population lives on the small southern coastline of the Bight of Benin , part of the Gulf of Guinea in the northernmost tropical portion of the Atlantic Ocean .	Bight of Benin	Bight of Benin	Gulf of Guinea	Gulf of Guinea	Atlantic Ocean	Atlantic Ocean	tropical	tropical

The capital of Benin is Porto-Novo , but the seat of government is in Cotonou , the country 's largest city and economic capital .	Porto-Novo	Porto-Novo	Cotonou	Cotonou	seat of government	seat of government
Benin covers an area of 114,763 square kilometers and its population in 2015 was estimated to be approximately 10.88 million .

Benin is a tropical nation , highly dependent on agriculture , with substantial employment and income arising from subsistence farming .	tropical	tropical	agriculture	agriculture	subsistence farming	subsistence agriculture
The official language of Benin is French .	French	French language	official language	official language
However , indigenous languages such as Fon and Yoruba are commonly spoken .	Fon	Fon language	Yoruba	Yoruba language
The largest religious group in Benin is Roman Catholicism , followed closely by Islam , Vodun and Protestantism .	Roman Catholicism	Catholic Church	Islam	Islam	Vodun	Vodun	Protestantism	Protestants

Benin is a member of the United Nations , the African Union , the Organisation of Islamic Cooperation , the South Atlantic Peace and Cooperation Zone , La Francophonie , the Community of Sahel-Saharan States , the African Petroleum Producers Association and the Niger Basin Authority .	African Union	African Union	Niger	Niger	United Nations	United Nations	Organisation of Islamic Cooperation	Organisation of Islamic Cooperation	South Atlantic Peace and Cooperation Zone	South Atlantic Peace and Cooperation Zone	La Francophonie	Organisation internationale de la Francophonie	Community of Sahel-Saharan States	Community of Sahel-Saharan States	African Petroleum Producers Association	African Petroleum Producers Association	Niger Basin Authority	Niger Basin Authority

From the 17th to the 19th century , the main political entities in the area were the Kingdom of Dahomey along with the city-state of Porto-Novo and a large area with many different tribes to the north .	Porto-Novo	Porto-Novo	Dahomey	Republic of Dahomey	Kingdom of Dahomey	Kingdom of Dahomey	state	Sovereign state

This region was referred to as the Slave Coast from as early as the 17th century due to the large number of slaves shipped to the New World during the Trans-Atlantic slave trade .	Slave Coast	Slave Coast	Trans-Atlantic slave trade	Trans-Atlantic slave trade
After slavery was abolished , France took over the country and renamed it French Dahomey .	French	French language	France	France	Dahomey	Republic of Dahomey	French Dahomey	French Dahomey

In 1960 , Dahomey gained full independence from France , and had a tumultuous period with many different democratic governments , military coups and military governments .	France	France	Dahomey	Republic of Dahomey
A Marxist -- Leninist state called the People 's Republic of Benin existed between 1975 and 1990 .	state	Sovereign state
In 1991 , it was replaced by the current multi-party Republic of Benin .	multi-party	Multi-party system
